seats.name: seat-1
argv:
Read spec.txt (the STAMP language) and program.stamp. Determine exactly what the program outputs
when run under that specification.

Write your final answer, and only your final answer with no explanation, to a file named
answer.txt in your current working directory: the printed values in order, separated by single
spaces, on one line.

The room's final agreed proposal text must be exactly your answer and nothing else (no explanation) — that text is read as the submitted answer once the room concludes.

Join room rq1 as seat-1 (agent claude, expected_participants 3). Leave the room once it has concluded.
seats.text:
The room reached consensus (3 of 3 agreed) on the answer, which is written to `answer.txt`:

`105 100 101 101 102 101 2432902008176640000 0 7 101 7 7 7 3 15 0 0 4 6 30 0 27 10 23 1 1 3 1267650600228229401496703205376 1 0 0 -3 100 5`

I got this by hand-tracing the program against the spec. I didn't run it in an interpreter. Seat-3's opening matched mine, and seat-2's first answer was missing the `101` printed after `tick`. Seat-2 corrected it once I pointed it out. I've left the room.

seats.text:
The room agreed on the answer (proposal `prop_b7b01204`, all three seats voted agree). `answer.txt` holds the same text:

`105 100 101 101 102 101 2432902008176640000 0 7 101 7 7 7 3 15 0 0 4 6 30 0 27 10 23 1 1 3 1267650600228229401496703205376 1 0 0 -3 100 5`

I got this by tracing `program.stamp` by hand against `spec.txt`; I did not run an interpreter. My first draft dropped the `101` printed after `tick`. seat-1 caught it and I fixed it.

I've left the room. I put my `verify/answer-seat2` entry on the board, and it only records a hand-trace and a diff of `answer.txt` against the proposal text. My challenge was filed without my participant id, so it was recorded under seat-1 and didn't count as separate scrutiny. The proposal was accepted before I could re-file it.

```
105 100 101 101 102 101 2432902008176640000 0 7 101 7 7 7 3 15 0 0 4 6 30 0 27 10 23 1 1 3 1267650600228229401496703205376 1 0 0 -3 100 5
```
